ADVISORY AGREEMENT

Between Willow Creek Advisors and Xeno Bank.

Section 3. Ownership. The parties acknowledge that a material change in the ownership structure of either party should be disclosed promptly in writing.

Liability is capped at advisory fees. Signed. Signature: Ada Gold. Signature: Bo Finn.

evidence.quote: The parties acknowledge that a material change in the ownership structure of either party should be disclosed promptly in writing.

expected.rationale: Disclosure-only language around an ownership change with no consent, notice-obligation, or termination consequence stated. A low-severity flag or no flag are both reasonable; needs_legal_review.
